experiment: direct A4 phase steps from executed candidate DAC MSB samples

fixture.capture: free-running sample each 1500 microinstructions at PCs 127-12A
fixture.phasor: 8 raw MSB samples per symbol at 1800 Hz
fixture.primary_phase_sign: negative from four-visit D127 phase rule

limitations: The raw candidate DAC MSB is an executed digital output under a field map and board scenario, not a verified Nokia line signal.
The sample clock, Y7-to-latch-to-DAC08 B1 route, DAC current conversion and analog output are untraced.
The controller TxD sequence is executed but projected onto the DSC schedule; the phase expectation uses the proposed D127 four-visit input rule.
